newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks fall for second day running.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks fall for second day running.

text.p: The Madrid bourse ended lower on Thursday in the second day of a correction amid falls abroad and a willingness to take profits after recent gains.
"The market is continuing to correct, but the tone is good and if the fall doesn't last long we could continue to rise," a dealer at Renta 4 said.
The general index ended down 8.72 points, or 1.54 percent, at 556.14, while the Index-35 fell 105.76, or 1.62 percent, to 6,416.49.
Market volume was high, but beneath Wednesday's levels, with value of 85.45 billion pesetas traded.

Energy group Repsol bucked the market trend, rising 40 pesetas, or 0.66 percent, to 6,110. Dealers said it was benefitting from investors who were looking for a share with room to rise after it failed to keep pace with recent market gains.
